item.case_name: Mood or music piece, no dialogue
item.title: Quiet After the Rain

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen mood film: a lonely bus stop after rain, late at night. Melancholy but peaceful, with gentle movement. Completely silent, no dialogue or text.

item.tests: Tests whether a short silent film conveys a specified mood through imagery, lighting and movement rather than dialogue or explanatory text.

answer_sheet.Setting and mood: A lonely bus stop after rain at night; melancholy but peaceful.
answer_sheet.Visual style and camera movement: Gentle movement; other visual choices are your call.

must_haves: The delivered video lasts approximately 10 seconds and is landscape 9:16.
A lonely bus stop at night is clearly visible, with wet surfaces or puddles establishing recent rain.
Subdued lighting and unhurried pacing convey a melancholy, peaceful mood rather than suspense or excitement.
There is visible gentle movement, such as rippling reflections or a slow camera move, rather than a static image held for the entire clip.
The video is silent and contains no titles, captions or dialogue.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from widescreen 16:9); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else the same.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A 10-second widescreen cinematic mood film, one continuous shot. A lonely, empty bus stop on a quiet street late at night, just after rain. An unoccupied simple glass shelter and bench sit beneath a soft warm streetlamp; cool blue night surrounds them. Wet asphalt and shallow puddles reflect the amber light. Melancholy but peaceful, intimate, understated photorealistic cinematography with subtle film grain. Gentle movement only: an extremely slow smooth camera push toward the shelter, occasional drops falling from its roof making delicate ripples in a puddle, a faint breeze moving nearby leaves. Consistent scene throughout, no cuts, no dramatic events, no people or arriving buses. All shelter panels and surfaces are blank: no advertisements, no lettering, no readable signs, no captions, no logos, no text anywhere. Completely silent: no music, no ambience, no sound effects, no dialogue, no audio.
